# Kaveri Industries

> Manufacturer of high-tensile MS (mild steel) fasteners — hex bolts, hex nuts, nylock nuts, slotted nuts, studs, threaded bars, U-bolts, center bolts, and washers — for B2B customers in infrastructure, energy, railways, telecom towers, refineries, and wind power. ISO 9001:2015 certified. Based in Bangalore, Karnataka, India.

The company specialises in precision-engineered structural fasteners engineered to demanding dimensional and mechanical tolerances, with in-house tensile and hardness testing on every production lot.

## Company facts

- Legal name: Kaveri Industries
- ISO certification: ISO 9001:2015
- Headquarters: Bangalore, Karnataka, India
- Primary products: high-tensile MS hex bolts (M6–M50), hex/slotted/nylock nuts, studs, U-bolts, center bolts, washers
- Manufacturing philosophy: zero-defect objective, process-integrated quality control
